title: openai-compat: support Responses API variants + seed/determinism + metadata passthrough (streaming & structured output)
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: The OpenAI Responses API surface has evolved (multiple response variants, explicit seed/determinism flags, and richer metadata). To maintain compatibility for customers using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and to support deterministic testing, this PR implements: (1) response variant mapping (chat vs. assistant vs. response objects), (2) explicit seed and determinism passthrough to the runtime with validation/guardrails, (3) metadata passthrough and preservation in streaming and non-streaming flows, and (4) structured output handling for function/tool calling and JSON/structured responses.

What changed:
- Add adapter layer that normalizes upstream "Responses" payloads into Redwood's internal request model and back. Handles variant negotiation so requests that specify response_type or variant are routed correctly.
- Wire seed and determinism flags through the compatibility shim into the serving runtime. Flags are validated (range check for seed, mutually-exclusive deterministic modes clarified) and surfaced to evaluation harnesses.
- Implement metadata passthrough: client-supplied metadata fields are preserved and attached to the returned response object and logs/tracing. Sensitive keys are filtered by opt-in allowlist.
- Streaming stability: extended the streaming handler to clamp chunk sizes, ensure consistent event ordering, and emit structured event types for chunk/meta/end. Added additional buffering on the compatibility layer to avoid partial-metadata emissions.
- Structured output & function calling: compatibility layer honors "tools"/"functions" fields and returns a consistent structured payload that mirrors OpenAI shape (including tool_invocation records).
- Tests and docs: integration tests covering response variants, seed/determinism behavior, metadata passthrough, and streaming order. Documentation updates with examples and a migration note.

Compatibility notes: The adapter accepts both legacy "chat.completions" shapes and the newer "responses" variants; when ambiguous the request's explicit "response_variant" field is authoritative. Default behavior remains unchanged for users not using the new fields.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implementation and unit tests
- [x] Integration tests against eval harness
- [x] Documentation updates and changelog entry
- [x] CI green and manual smoke-tested streaming behavior

Backports/Follow-ups: A small follow-up will expose an admin toggle for stricter metadata allowlists (ENG-3301). There is also a follow-up to add SDK convenience helpers in the Python and TS SDKs to set seeds deterministically (tracked under ENG-3350).

release_notes: Added OpenAI Responses compatibility: response variants, seed/determinism passthrough, metadata preservation in responses and streaming, and improved structured output handling for tool/function calling. Backwards compatible for existing chat completions users.
notes: This change is primarily additive and opt-in; we validated performance impact on the streaming path (negligible) and added guardrails for metadata to avoid accidental PII leakage.
